note: Eight players, two courts: the four first-round matchUps fill row 1 left to right, then row 2.
Four players, four courts, both rounds profiled: the final depends on both semifinals, so it is not on their row.
One court, the final profiled before the semifinals: while a source is unplaced the final is offered to the next row, so the semifinals take rows 1 and 2 and the final row 3.
A limit of one matchUp a day: the semifinals are placed; every player who can reach the final has played once, so the final is over the limit and not placed.
The same limit, asked only to warn: the final is placed on row 2 and warned.
Three courts, the call names the third: every placement is on it, one row each.
The same two players in two events, two courts: their first-round matchUps share both players, so the second is not on the first one's row.
